facts.text: I have been living in Tokyo, Japan for about 6 months.
I am interested in museums and galleries in Tokyo that are off the beaten path.
I am interested in the Impressionism and Post-Impressionism collections.
I want to see Van Gogh's "Wheat Field with Cypresses" up close.
I think I will take advantage of an audio guide and maybe join a guided tour.
I want cafes or restaurants within the museum or nearby where I can take a break and discuss the art with my friends.

I have found cafes and restaurants nearby that are perfect for taking a break and discussing the artwork.
